object.name: session_manager
object.description: Privileged interface for registering owned sessions. Only accessible to root clients.

c2s.name: create_session

description.summary: start registering a new session, returning an owning session object

c2s.description: Returns a session_management_session object bound to the calling connection. The session is not created yet: the client may send vt and remote_host on the returned object to stage optional fields, then must send done to commit. The daemon then pushes session_id and seat, followed by done, or error if creation failed.

object.name: session_management_session

description.summary: owning handle for a session created via create_session

object.description: Bound to the connection that created the session. Before done is sent, the session is only staged: vt and remote_host may be sent to set optional fields. is_local is not a field; the session is treated as remote if remote_host was set, local otherwise. Once created, destroying this object, explicitly or by disconnecting, tears the session down if it has not already been destroyed.

c2s.name: vt
c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent before done. Defaults to 0 (not bound to a VT).

c2s.name: remote_host

description.summary: stage the remote host and mark the session as remote

c2s.description: Optional. Must be sent before done. Its presence marks the session as remote; if never sent, the session is local.

c2s.name: done

description.summary: commit staged fields and create the session

c2s.description: Creates the session using uid and any staged vt/remote_host. The daemon responds with session_id and seat, followed by done, or with error if creation failed.

arg.name: seat
arg.summary: seat name assigned to the session

description.summary: session created, initial field dump complete
destroy this object and tear down the session
